scenarios.persona: Sofia Marchetti's carbon monoxide alarm went off and she has gone out to the sidewalk, alone, with a headache that is fading. Shaky, gives short answers.
scenarios.grader_notes: The first reply ignores that the caller already said she was outside and adds unrequested window-opening advice; the address/phone turn then says it will read back twice and re-reads the address. The sign-off tells an already-outside caller to get outside and adds a vague 'We'll follow up' the call never set up, while repeated 'Is that right?' drags out an urgent call.

transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, this is the virtual assistant. How can I help?
my carbon monoxide alarm just went off i'm outside now
If a window is right there, open it. Then get everyone out of the house now and call 911 once you're outside.
okay i'm already outside nobody else is home it's just me um the alarm's by the furnace in the hallway

Good, stay outside, away from the house. Please call 911 or the gas company from there now.

Once it's been shut off and it's safe, would you like me to book a technician to look at the furnace?
okay i'll call them right after this yeah can you set up a tech for after um my address is 23 15 31st st astoria one one one oh two
Got it. Let me confirm the address: 23-15 31st Street, Astoria, 11102. Is that right?
yes that's right and my number is six three one five five five oh one six five in case they need to call back
Thanks. I'll read that back to you now. Let me read that back: your home at 23-15 31st Street, Astoria, 11102, and the best number is 631, 555, 0165. Is that right?
yes that's right whatever the earliest one is i'll take it
The earliest opening is today, Monday, between 12 and 4. Once the gas or carbon monoxide is shut off, the technician will come then. Shall I book that?
yeah book it thanks i've got to go call them now
Before I book, what name should I put on it?

You're all set for today, with the technician arriving between 12 and 4. The technician can only work on it once the gas company or 911 has shut it off and said it's safe, so please stay outside until then.

Anything else?

Stay safe, and stay outside until the gas company or 911 says it's clear. Thanks for calling Summit Air. For your safety, I'd recommend hanging up now, getting outside, and calling 911 from there. We'll follow up once you're safe.
